My plot is small, only 0.56 hectare, and I plant yam with cassava between them like my father taught me. I have no money for much fertilizer this year, but I will try to buy one bag of NPK from the agro-dealer if the price is fair, and I will carry goat and chicken droppings from my compound to put in the yam heaps. I use the yam setts I kept from last harvest — improved seed is too costly and hard to find for yam in my area. My wife and children will help me with the weeding and harvesting, but for making the heaps at the start of the season my back is not strong like before, so I will hire some young men from the village for a few days.
